name: A: Learnable noise dampening
theory: EXHAUSTED. CRPS-optimal rho ≈ 0.29 produces poor distributional properties (KS, kurtosis). Fixed rho=0.8 is the correct inductive bias. Clamped rho creates gradient desert.
finding: 103a: rho→0.29, KS 17/25. 103a_v2: rho stuck at 0.703, score=baseline.

name: B: Encoder-modulated per-cell noise scale
theory: REDUNDANT with cell_spread — proven by 102a. Both condition→25 scalars on same path.
finding: 102a: 1.4x range (GT: 35x). Kurtosis regressed. Better calibration but no suite flip.

name: C: Non-anchored dynamics / level prediction
theory: Additive iv_t = prev + vs*delta anchors all trajectories to history[-1]. KS on IV levels fails 0-1/25. A horizon-dependent drift head or mean-reversion to learned long-run mean could break anchor dependency.
prediction: KS on IV levels should improve from 0-1/25.
risk: May break surface validity. CRPS rewards anchoring (best per-step prediction).
implementation: Horizon-dependent drift head: drift_head(condition, horizon) → (25,) cumulative offset added at each step. Or: mean_revert_head(condition) → (25,) learned long-run mean, with iv_t pulled toward it.
